from scipy.optimize import least_squares
SPEC=json.load(open('/app/output/spec.json'))
LIMIT=np.array(SPEC['action_types']['joint_position']['panda_joint_limits_rad'])
def tf(p=(0,0,0),rot=None):
 t=np.eye(4);t[:3,3]=p
 if rot is not None:t[:3,:3]=rot
 return t
ORIGINS=[((0,0,.333),0),((0,0,0),-np.pi/2),((0,-.316,0),np.pi/2),((.0825,0,0),np.pi/2),((-.0825,.384,0),-np.pi/2),((0,0,0),np.pi/2),((.088,0,0),np.pi/2)]
def fk(q,offset=.107):
 t=tf((0,-.4,.6),R.from_euler('z',np.pi/2).as_matrix())
 for (p,rx),a in zip(ORIGINS,q):
  t=t@tf(p,R.from_euler('x',rx).as_matrix())@tf(rot=R.from_euler('z',a).as_matrix())

 return t[:3,:3]@local+t[:3,3]

"""One-episode camera-guided Panda controller, with every executed target recorded.
Only rcb_client is used to access the robot. Kinematics are standard Panda geometry.
Usage: gen.py observe NAME | move NAME X Y Z FINGER SECONDS [YAW] | grip NAME WIDTH SECONDS
The append-only actions.jsonl records the complete sequence for this run.
"""
import argparse
import json
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation as R
from rcb_client import Robot
from geometry import fk, ik, DOWN, LIMIT
OUT=Path('/app/output')

def save_result(res,name):
 res.save(OUT/name)
 (OUT/'latest.json').write_text(json.dumps(res.meta,indent=2))
 print(json.dumps({'name':name,'steps':res.meta['control_steps'],'done':res.done,'reason':res.meta.get('reason'),'proprio':res.meta['proprio']['now'][:23]},indent=2),flush=True)

def submit(r,rows,name):
 rows=np.asarray(rows)
 assert np.all(rows[:,:7]>=LIMIT[:,0]) and np.all(rows[:,:7]<=LIMIT[:,1])
 with (OUT/'actions.jsonl').open('a') as f:
  f.write(json.dumps({'name':name,'type':'joint_position','dt':.1,'targets':rows.tolist()})+'\n')
 res=r.submit('joint_position',rows,dt=.1,cameras=['forward','left','right','wrist'],video='none',include_depth=True,note=name)
 save_result(res,name)
 return res

def current(r):return np.array(r.get_obs(cameras=[],video='none').meta['proprio']['now'])
def move(r,name,pos,width,seconds,yaw=None):
 p=current(r);q=p[:7];start=fk(q);rot=DOWN if yaw is None else R.from_euler('xyz',[np.pi,0,yaw]).as_matrix()
 n=int(round(seconds/.1));rows=[]
 rstart=R.from_matrix(start[:3,:3]);dr=R.from_matrix(rot@start[:3,:3].T).as_rotvec()
 for i in range(1,n+1):
  a=i/n;a=a*a*(3-2*a)
  target=start[:3,3]*(1-a)+np.array(pos)*a
  orient=R.from_rotvec(dr*a).as_matrix()@start[:3,:3]
  q=ik(target,orient,q)
  rows.append(np.r_[q,width,width])
 return submit(r,rows,name)

if __name__=='__main__':
 import sys
 r=Robot();cmd=sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv)>1 else 'observe';name=sys.argv[2] if len(sys.argv)>2 else 'initial'
 if cmd=='observe':save_result(r.get_obs(include_depth=True,video='none'),name)
 elif cmd=='move':move(r,name,list(map(float,sys.argv[3:6])),float(sys.argv[6]),float(sys.argv[7]),float(sys.argv[8]) if len(sys.argv)>8 else None)
 elif cmd=='grip':
  p=current(r);width=float(sys.argv[3]);n=round(float(sys.argv[4])/.1)
  submit(r,np.tile(np.r_[p[23:30],width,width],(n,1)),name)
 elif cmd=='joints':
  p=current(r);target=np.array(list(map(float,sys.argv[3:12])));n=round(float(sys.argv[12])/.1)
  submit(r,np.array([p[23:32]+(target-p[23:32])*(3*(i/n)**2-2*(i/n)**3) for i in range(1,n+1)]),name)
